analytics.name: Analytic 0992
analytics.guidance: Detect suspicious file creations and process executions triggered by browser activity (e.g., injected payloads written to %AppData% or Temp directories, then executed). Correlate network anomalies with subsequent local process creation or script execution.

tuning.description: File extensions to flag (exe, dll, js, vbs, sh, etc.).
Browser processes (chrome.exe, firefox.exe, edge.exe, etc.) monitored as possible parents for malicious activity.
List of suspicious domains or URLs used for malicious redirects.

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: Unexpected script or binary content returned in HTTP response body

analytics.name: Analytic 0993
analytics.guidance: Detect curl/wget commands saving executable/script payloads to /tmp or /var/tmp followed by execution. Monitor packet captures or IDS/IPS alerts for injected responses or mismatched content types.

tuning.description: Directories such as /tmp and /var/tmp where injected files are often written.

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: execve: Execution of curl or wget writing files to /tmp/* followed by chmod or execution

log_sources.name: WinEventLog:Sysmon
log_sources.channel: File creation of suspicious scripts/binaries in temporary directories

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: Injected content responses with unexpected script/malware signatures

analytics.name: Analytic 0994
analytics.guidance: Monitor unified logs for processes spawned from Safari or other browsers that immediately load scripts or executables. Detect file drops in ~/Library/Caches or ~/Downloads that execute shortly after being written.

tuning.description: macOS-specific directories where malicious payloads may be written.

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Child processes of Safari, Chrome, or Firefox executing scripting interpreters

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: File creation of unsigned binaries/scripts in user cache or download directories

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
